newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom denies Concert chosen.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom denies Concert chosen.

text.p: Portugal Telecom (PT) denied on Wednesday a newspaper report that it had opted for the British Telecom -MCI Communications Corp alliance Concert as its strategic partner.
"No decision has yet been taken (over the strategic partner), spokesman Jose Maria Amado told Reuters.

Amado said a study on potential alliances being drawn up for Telecom by Morgan Grenfell and Arthur D. Little, and on which the state-controlled concern would base its opinion, was not yet ready. The company will make a recommendation but it is up to the government to take the final decision on the alliance.
